description: Source code for TaskManager and AbortListener classes managing task scheduling, abort notifications, and pub/sub communication in the Global Task Framework (GTF) within the Superset project.

classes.name: AbortListener
classes.description: Handles background listening for task abort signals via pub/sub or polling, allowing for clean shutdown.

classes.name: TaskManager
classes.description: Manages task creation, scheduling, abort notification, and communication via Redis pub/sub or database polling.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes TaskManager with Flask app configuration for channel prefixes.

methods.name: _get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache backend used for pub/sub communication.

methods.name: is_pubsub_available
methods.description: Checks if Redis pub/sub backend is configured and available.

methods.name: get_abort_channel
methods.description: Generates the Redis channel name for abort notifications for a specific task.

methods.name: publish_abort
methods.description: Publishes an abort message to the task's Redis channel.

methods.name: get_completion_channel
methods.description: Generates the Redis channel name for task completion notifications.

methods.name: publish_completion
methods.description: Publishes task completion status to the Redis channel.

methods.name: wait_for_completion
methods.description: Blocks until the task reaches a terminal state, using pub/sub or polling.

methods.name: _wait_via_pubsub
methods.description: Waits for task completion via Redis pub/sub messages.

methods.name: _wait_via_polling
methods.description: Waits for task completion via database polling.

methods.name: listen_for_abort
methods.description: Starts listening for abort signals for a specific task, using pub/sub or polling.

methods.name: _invoke_callback_with_context
methods.description: Executes a callback within Flask app context if provided.

methods.name: _check_abort_status
methods.description: Checks if a task has been marked as aborted in the database.

methods.name: _run_abort_listener_loop
methods.description: Core loop for abort listening, handling checks and callback invocation.

methods.name: _listen_pubsub
methods.description: Listens for abort signals via Redis pub/sub.

methods.name: _poll_for_abort
methods.description: Polls the database for abort status when Redis pub/sub is unavailable.

methods.name: submit_task
methods.description: Creates a task entry and schedules its execution, handling deduplication and task properties.
